title: The kit-not-installed remedy names the package route
summary: IA-CORE-KIT-NOT-INSTALLED now leads its remedy with ia install --package <name> --apply and names @inventarch/public-kits, where the public kits ship, because ia install <id> reaches only a registry release and refuses the public kits. ia install <id> --apply is kept for kits a registry serves, and kit.mjs add <id> is unchanged. The code, the kit field and when the refusal fires are unchanged; only the message text differs.
